digest.component_or_area: plan-review attestation gate and signed manifest validity
propositions: A plan-review attestation can remain valid after a direct child or prerequisite changes its plan, letting agents rely on stale plan assumptions.
Every new plan review must record signed plan-material pins binding each direct child and prerequisite's canonical ID, role, and current material fingerprint.
When enforcement is enabled, material drift in a pinned target invalidates the downstream attestation; when disabled, drift is reported but advisory and validity stays true.
Legacy unpinned attestations remain valid and older readers ignore additive pin manifest lines without breaking signature verification.
An internal reducer-maintained plan_review_phase projection (planning/execution) drives execution reviews carrying a fixed 0.80 priority-floor and survives compaction.

A close gate requires a current certified compatible plan review when enabled, ignoring code freshness, and a specialized prerequisite-consistency criterion emits one three-disposition coverage record per readable prerequisite.
